ai.codriverlabs:scaleout-build-ecs 1.0.0 发布, ECS task orchestration, S3 staging, and native-image input planning. Extracted from
        scaleout-build-maven-plugin so that both the plugin's direct-ECS backend and the
        control-plane service can launch and supervise build tasks without the service having to
        depend on the Maven plugin (and therefore on maven-plugin-api).

        Named for ECS because that is the only backend today. If a second backend appears (see
        docs/design/control-plane/scaleout-builder-control-plane.md's MicroVM note), the launch
        abstraction belongs here and the module is worth renaming then rather than pre-emptively.

items.title:
fr.mieuxvoter:kmj-android 0.3.0 发布, A Kotlin Multiplatform library to efficiently rank candidates using Majority Judgment.
Majority Judgment is an elegant voting system used in french wine contests, among other things.
Its resolution does not require a computer, but it's still handy to be able to do it digitally.

This library supports arbitrarily large amounts of voters — and millions of candidates.
In addition to ranking, it also provides an extensive analysis of the merit profiles,
including a scalar majority merit value that can be useful in a number of ways.

For impeccable accuracy and reliability, this library does not use floating-point numbers.
It also provides three utilities to balance your tallies, including a Least-Common-Multiple-based normalization.

items.title:
fr.mieuxvoter:kmj-jvm 0.3.0 发布, A Kotlin Multiplatform library to efficiently rank candidates using Majority Judgment.
Majority Judgment is an elegant voting system used in french wine contests, among other things.
Its resolution does not require a computer, but it's still handy to be able to do it digitally.

This library supports arbitrarily large amounts of voters — and millions of candidates.
In addition to ranking, it also provides an extensive analysis of the merit profiles,
including a scalar majority merit value that can be useful in a number of ways.

For impeccable accuracy and reliability, this library does not use floating-point numbers.
It also provides three utilities to balance your tallies, including a Least-Common-Multiple-based normalization.
